verdict.rationale: The x402 Bazaar is a public, cross-merchant catalog of more than 23,000 payment-gated services. Agents can search it by intent, with network, asset, scheme and price filters, through the discovery APIs, the SDK or the Bazaar MCP server, and no CDP API key or partnership is needed. A runtime probe confirmed that a keyless GET returned real payable-service listings. Missing for 10: hands-on corroboration of the search endpoint itself (the probe exercised the listing endpoint), and coverage beyond x402-gated API resources (search caps at 20 results per query).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can programmatically search products or services across merchants — keylessly or with self-service credentials, no private partnership required

citations.quote: Bazaar discovery is public. You do not need a CDP API key to use the discovery APIs or the corresponding TypeScript SDK functions.
Search returns at most 20 resources, ranked by a blend of query relevance and quality.
The x402 Bazaar lists more than 23,000 x402 resources.
Let an MCP-compatible agent discover services with tool calls.
a plain GET to https://api.cdp.coinbase.com/platform/v2/x402/discovery/resources returned real payable-service listings
There is no registration form or separate API call.
